annotations.title: Check Korea family low price sale

description: Korean below-market sale between related parties: buyer gift (상증법 제35조①) when market value − price ≥ min(30% of market value, 300M KRW), gift value = the difference minus that threshold; seller capital gains recomputed at market value (소득세법 제101조, 시행령 제167조③) when the difference ≥ min(5%, 300M KRW). Returns both tests, gift tax and the lowest prices that avoid each.
